summary.text: The CPF Board sends the moneys to the Public Trustee, who contacts the informant or next of kin.

details.heading: When to apply
details.body: Apply only after the Public Trustee has received the moneys from CPF Board.

details.heading: What to have ready
details.body: You will need to have your Singpass ready to access the online application form. If you are ineligible for a Singpass, you may apply for a login ID and password.

steps.name: Wait for the transfer
steps.text: Wait for CPF Board to transfer the moneys to the Public Trustee. This takes around 17 working days after CPF Board is notified of the death.

steps.name: Wait for contact
steps.text: Wait for the Public Trustee to write to the person who informed CPF Board about the death, and/or the Deceased's next of kin.

steps.name: Apply online
steps.text: After the Public Trustee has received the moneys, the next of kin can apply online for the Public Trustee to distribute them. A friend may apply on the next of kin's behalf.

sources.page_title: What happens to the Deceased’s un-nominated Central Provident Fund (“CPF”) moneys

quotes.text: When a CPF member passed away without nominating anyone to receive his / her CPF moneys, the CPF Board will transfer these moneys to the Public Trustee for distribution to the rightful beneficiary.
Upon being notified of the death, CPF Board takes around 17 working days to transfer the moneys to the Public Trustee.
The next of kin can then apply online for the Public Trustee to distribute the moneys.
Only after the Public Trustee has received the moneys from CPF Board.
You will need to have your Singpass ready in order to access our online application form.
